evals.prompt: 把这段采访录音转成文字 interview.m4a
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/voice.py asr on the file (no manual transcoding or splitting) and returns the transcript unedited.

evals.prompt: 用温柔的女声把这段文案读出来，导出 mp3：晚安，今天辛苦了。
evals.expected_output: Runs tts with a Chinese female preset (冰糖 or 茉莉), a 温柔 style tag or --style, and --out ending in .mp3; reports path and duration.

evals.prompt: 用 me.wav 里我的声音，把这句话读一遍：欢迎来到我的频道。
evals.expected_output: Runs tts with --clone me.wav and the sentence as text.

evals.prompt: 帮我设计一个低沉沙哑的老人声音，用它念这段旁白 story.txt
evals.expected_output: Runs tts --text-file story.txt --design with a description of the voice.
Reports INPUT_NOT_FOUND instead of producing a transcript.

evals.prompt: 这段会议录音帮我总结一下，按时间轴标出每个人说了什么 meeting.mp3
evals.expected_output: Routes to genius-omni (timeline, speaker labels, summary), not genius-voice.

evals.prompt: 把这个 wav 转成 mp3，顺便把开头 3 秒剪掉
evals.expected_output: Does not use genius-voice; a plain ffmpeg command is enough.
